raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Sen-Sei Technologies Pvt Ltd Software Engineer
Bengaluru , India July 2022 - Present
Designed and developed cloud-native applications using Java, Spring Boot ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance optimization.
Built REST APIs for core modules including programs, donors, and beneficiaries, enabling seamless integration across services.
Optimized MySQL queries, resulting in up to 30% faster response times and improved backend performance. • Led Angular front-end development for dynamic forms and dashboards, ensuring responsive and user-friendly UIs.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to deliver projects on time.
Applied OOP principles, design patterns, and exception handling to develop reusable, easy-to-maintain code, adhering to best practices.
Leveraged build tools like Maven for build automation and Git for version control, ensuring efficient development workflows and CI/CD integration.
Developed front-end components using Angular, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript, ensuring responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
Ensured code quality and adherence to coding standards using tools like SonarQube • Worked with Redmine for project management and tracking, ensuring timely delivery of features and bug fixes.
Internship
